summary: A target-valid 5x5 symmetric matrix with eigenvalues -1,-1,1-sqrt(2),1,1+sqrt(2) has a physical 2x2 pre-pivot cross block equal to I_2, but completing the nonzero scalar pivot subtracts a rank-one outer product and leaves diag(0,1). Thus two pre-pivot cross directions need not survive as two post-Schur directions; only the rank-one interlacing guarantee sigma_j(C')>=sigma_{j+1}(C) is generally valid. This does not refute QFORM.
